title: an explicit @any boundary boxes a heterogeneous literal
purpose: Observe type, generic and collection semantics.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 6.2 and 6.6.2: only explicit boundaries box values into any; owner decision on #315: a literal passed directly to an @any parameter is boxed, an untyped local first is rejected.
